up: Find all compound records that have a document with the CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5729049'. Return the molecule's public ChEMBL identifier, the internal numeric molregno, the compound's preferred name (pref_name), and the document's title (title). Use the molecule_dictionary, compound_records, and docs tables to retrieve these items. Include all qualifying compound records; do not filter out any rows based on assay or activity information because the user only asked for compounds associated with the specified document. Ensure results preserve any duplicate entries if a molecule appears multiple times in that document.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.molregno, md.pref_name, d.title
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729049'
